outlook_list_messages.afterResponse:
const messages = response.value || [];
return {messages, count: messages.length, hasMore: !!response['@odata.nextLink'], nextLink: response['@odata.nextLink'] || null};

outlook_send_email.label: Send Email
outlook_send_email.description: Composes and sends a new email.

recipients.label: To Email(s)
recipients.description: Email addresses of the primary recipients. A JSON list of addresses, such as ["ada@example.com"].

ccRecipients.label: CC Email(s)
ccRecipients.description: A JSON list of addresses, such as ["ada@example.com"].

bccRecipients.label: BCC Email(s)
bccRecipients.description: A JSON list of addresses, such as ["ada@example.com"].

outlook_send_email.afterResponse:
const list = (v) => { if (v === undefined || v === null || v === '') return []; try { const p = JSON.parse(v); return Array.isArray(p) ? p : [p]; } catch (e) { return String(v).split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter((s) => s); } };
return {success: true, message: 'Email sent successfully.', subject: inputs.subject, recipients: list(inputs.recipients)};
